submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective detector for nominal/numeral phrase completion: it peaks on the head noun, proper-noun piece, compound/predicative adjective, or digit/space-before-digit that completes a determiner-, quantifier- or measure-headed entity, measure or time phrase (heavy rain, sea level, last year, the Moon, capital cities, not guilty, chemical energy, triangle inequality, 3.9 percent, 500 mg, from 9, galaxy 13, range(10), zeros((3)), plus the clause-final intransitive verb/adverb that closes a definite-subject clause (symphony began., so fast., bloomed again.); it stays quiet on bare lexical verbs with complements or continuations (fast as 'will fast strictly', began taking an infinitive, to forgive, verb-chain bubbles), on qualitative attributive adjectives in abstract non-measure NPs (religious reasons), on spelled-out number words (thirty, seven, five hundred), and on identifier-glued code numerals outside loop/shape/measure frames (timeout(30), weak ~0.8).

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The research vessel left harbor before dawn with a full crew of oceanographers, technicians, and graduate students eager to survey the southern reef. For the first week the seas were calm and the divers logged every coral head, sponge garden, and sandy channel they encountered along the transect lines. Equipment failures slowed the second week, when a faulty winch forced the team to haul nets by hand and recalibrate the depth sounders twice each day. Supplies ran low as the galley struggled to feed thirty people on rations meant for half that number, and morale dipped when storms confined everyone below deck for three straight days. Messages from shore brought news of funding cuts, permit delays, and a broken submersible that would not be repaired until winter. The senior scientist called long meetings to revise the sampling plan, reassign dive pairs, and stretch the remaining fuel across extra survey sites. Graduate students spent evenings entering data, cleaning filters, mending nets, and transcribing handwritten logs by lamplight. Compared with the past decade, coral growth has slowed dramatically across the entire study area. After that assessment the team redoubled its efforts, diving at sunrise and sunset to capture spawning events, tagging turtles, counting fish schools, and photographing bleached patches for later analysis. The final weeks brought clear water, steady winds, and long days of uninterrupted observation before the voyage home.
